posts.title: Untitled 2025.m3u
posts.description: A lot can be said about 2025. It was hard, fun, interesting, and chaotic. Thankfully, though, this isn’t a year in review; rather, it’s a year of music in review. I wanted to encapsulate my musical preferences this year in the form of a carefully curated playlist. I hope you enjoy! Where To Find You can find the original playlist on Spotify 1 . Additionally you can listen to most of it on YouTube
